gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. And Dogica goes the other way, heavy and widely tracked, built to make a heading feel like an announcement.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa reads friendly and unfussy, its round letters opening wide with short stems on the ascenders. But Dogica is the one that commands, heavy and widely spaced, while the body simply carries the words along.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC keeps its a, e and s generously open, with curves that flare outward rather than curling in. And Dogica supplies the weight up top, wide-tracked and heavy, so the body can be sized down without losing its footing.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, which gives it a brisk, businesslike look. And over many lines that openness keeps it from clotting, while Dogica stays out of the way up above, heavy and wide.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Heavy, wide, unmistakable: that is Dogica, with lowercase rising nearly to the capitals and every curve left open. Noto Sans Thaana is the gentler half, with wide channels leading into big counters, so enlarging it would blunt the heading's authority.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-thai: Chunky and commanding, Dogica spreads its heavy letters wide and leaves every curve open at the end. Noto Sans Thai answers with swollen, glass-bead lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to the height of its capitals, then spreads out with a wide, heavy tracking. Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall bodies that look bold already, so it needs no extra size to hold its own.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its letters round and inviting. Dogica is the heavy, widely tracked voice that commands attention, while the body's bowls fill the line like inflated shapes and make the reading easy.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta reads bright and modern, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps and a dominant x-height. Dogica's heavy, wide-set heading suits a larger size, so the body can stay modest.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Approachable describes Noto Sans Ugaritic, though Dogica gets there more forcefully, being heavy, widely tracked and open at every curve end. Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps x-height and cap height close together, its open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, which suits steady reading.
